movement_profile.formation_and_space: Dances are performed in couples, lines, or circles.
movement_profile.levels_and_jumps: Haute dances include leaps and lifts; basse dances keep feet low to the floor.
movement_profile.partnering: Some dances involve intimate holds and lifts, such as the volta.
